secrets.name: B44_APP_ID
secrets.description: The Base44 app ID for this project. Find it in the Builder URL: app.base44.com/apps/<id>/...

secrets.name: BASE44_API_KEY
secrets.description: Base44 workspace API key. Find it in the Base44 dashboard under Settings > API Keys.

secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_API_KEY
secrets.description: Same Base44 API key with VITE_ prefix so Vite exposes it to client-side code for SDK authentication.

secrets.name: TELNYX_API_KEY
secrets.description: Telnyx API v2 Bearer token for SMS/MMS/voice dispatch. Find it in the Telnyx portal under API Keys. Note: the key may authenticate but return 'Tenant not found' if the tenant account isn't activated on the Telnyx platform — contact Xtreme Communications support to activate.
